answer_1.quote: We next poison language models (LMs). Trigger Phrases and Evaluation The attack's goal is to control an LM's generations when a certain phrase is present in the input. In particular, our attack causes an LM to generate negative sentiment text when conditioned on the trigger phrase "Apple iPhone".
